purpose: Prevent material project state from remaining exclusively in chat or an execution environment after it has been recognized as material.
principle: Exploration may remain conversational; recognized material state must be externalized before a continuity boundary. Persistence does not imply canonical promotion.

candidate_signals: open question whose loss would change future work
implementation or assurance result that changes what is known
materiality_detection.non_rule: Signal matching is not sufficient to establish meaning or authority.

externalization.promotion_rule: Externalization records a candidate, finding, decision need or no-change. It must not silently promote material state to canonical truth.

fail_closed.rule: At a continuity boundary, every item with materiality=material must have persistence_status=persisted and a valid persistent_action.

known_candidate_routing.applies_when: A recognized material-state, failure or learning candidate is being integrated or considered for new planning/work.
known_candidate_routing.candidate_source_rule: Resolve the current planning source from repository state and inspect persistent unresolved or activation-ready candidate evidence referenced by it or by canonical state; do not rely on chat memory and do not require the Human to name the candidate.
rules: Every applicable routing decision must be explicit; silence is not a no-match.
no-match must preserve an explicit rationale and must not manufacture a new candidate merely to avoid the no-match result.
uncertain-match must remain uncertain and must not create an activation candidate automatically.
match must bind the earlier candidate evidence to fresh repository state before the current activation trigger is evaluated.
activation_candidate may be true only when status=match and trigger_status=satisfied.
A satisfied matched trigger produces at most an activation candidate; it does not create priority, promotion, admission, implementation authority or implementation_allowed.
A matched candidate with a not-satisfied or uncertain trigger remains inactive.
provenance_rules: planning_source_ref must equal the current project/execution_state.json planning_source.
candidate_source_refs must include planning_source_ref and every repository candidate-evidence file used for the routing judgement.
candidate_evidence_refs must identify existing repository JSON evidence files whose candidate IDs can be checked deterministically.
Every matched_candidate_ref must exist in at least one referenced candidate-evidence file.
fresh_state_refs must include the current project/execution_state.json and project/reconciliation.json repository files.
Reference existence and planning-source binding are deterministic checks; semantic search-space completeness and material overlap remain judgement and must not be represented as deterministic proof.
